lines: We approached the entrance gate with extreme caution. However―
The scene that met our eyes was completely unexpected.
Huh? What the hell is that...?
Huh!? How many times do I hafta tell y'all!? We ain't the slightest bit int'rested in pickin' a fight!!
The irritated shouting of the flame-wielding brute Hestia could be heard amidst intense sounds of battle that filled the whole area.
A battle had broken out between the residents of Yomihara and the UFS troops that had taken up positions in front of the gate.
(H-Hey, Fuma...!? What the hell is going on!!?)
(I-I don't know... but maybe they saw it as a threat when they tried to enter Yomihara to follow us...?)
―Then withdraw your troops!! This is a gate that we, Nomad, control!
Ahahaha! That's right!! Yomihara is not so easy of a target that you UFS lot can just waltz in.
The two senior executives of Nomad that I had only seen in documents were engaged in an intense battle with the cyborg soldier Hestia.
I'm like a broken record over here!! Them Taimanin are tryin' to nab our cyborg!!!
Ain't that horrible!? Ain't they the worst!? We just wanna put a stop to 'em!! We'll even pay, if it suits y'all's fancy!!
Now you've shown your true colors, you knave―. A Devildom Knight will not be lured by money!!
Oh, that doesn't sound too bad. Depending on your offer, I might listen to what you have to say☆
Ooohh～!! You there, dolled-up lady, you know what I'm talkin' 'bout!
Oboro!!? Try to be a bit more serious―
Ahaha! Just kidding♪ And it seems like taking that expensive-looking cyborg body would earn us more money anyway.
While they had their ridiculous back-and-forth, the three of them continued the fierce battle.
(Man, oh man, oh man... Those three are monsters...)
(...I know what this is. They've got cheat codes, yup, cheat codes!)
(Hmmm... If Hebiko had 10 more tentacles, that might just be enough to hang with them...)
This was a pair of Nomad senior executives who were said to have held their own in fights against Asagi-sensei, putting her in tough spots time and time again.
Even Hestia, whom we had struggled with so much, was completely on the defensive against Ingrid and Oboro.
But this is our chance! Now we can make it through the gate without being seen by the UFS!!
Oh? How dull... We aren't going to join in on that?
Still shocked by Yamata no Orochi's lust for battle, I spoke to everyone.
If we were to face those three monsters, no number of lives would be enough.
Let's choose a route right through their blind spot and get through here as quickly as possible.
